specification_title: Benchmark v2 Final Evaluation Protocol Specification

scoring_provenance.scoring_configuration: CUDA fp32, sigmoid activation, duplicate-exact cached

test_partition_status.historical_disclosure: Test partition papers were exposed during the archived invalid Stage 4 proxy experiment. No additional test-content access occurred during this repair or benchmark rebuild. Frozen prior to new v2 test construction.

hypotheses_and_comparisons.primary_hypothesis: M4 (Full Deduplicated) achieves lower discrete tie-correct AURC than M1 (Raw Relevance) on controlled contexts.

factorial_ablations.ablation: Structural features effect on raw passages
Structural features effect on deduplicated passages

practical_generalization_check.reporting: Reported separately from controlled contexts as the practical generalization check.

property_checks.duplicate_invariance: Evaluated separately from evidence-removal experiments to measure sensitivity to redundant passage duplication.

statistical_testing_protocol.cluster_policy: All conditions and question families associated with a primary source paper are kept together in each resample.
statistical_testing_protocol.interpretation_rule: Report the observed difference and bootstrap percentile interval as uncertainty estimates. An interval containing zero is compatible with differences in either direction and does not establish equivalence.
statistical_testing_protocol.dependence_disclosure: Shared distractor passages across families can create residual inter-cluster dependence.

threshold_evaluations.reporting: Both descriptive matched-coverage comparisons and deployable validation-frozen operating point performance must be reported.
